theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_cr_density_normalization
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (Q : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (e : Euclid Q), Measurable g → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K ≠ ∞) → μ = (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (g x)) → LocallyIntegrable (fun x => g x • e) μH[(n : ℝ)] ∧ ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → ∫ x, f x • (g x • e) ∂μH[(n : ℝ)] = (c * ∫ x, f x ∂μ) • e
